acquisition method: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed in a data-dependent mode with Full-MS with a resolution of 120,000 at m/z = 200
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 32%; normalized collision energy set to 15%

HCD-MS/MS (resolution of 15,000) of the most intense ions in 3 s was used to fragment multiply charged ions within a 1.4 Da isolation window at a normalized collision energy of 32%. ... HCD supplemental activation was enabled with normalized collision energy set to 15%.
enrichment method: we identified the protein substrates of TMTC1 using a glycoproteomic approach... performing the ConA pull-down assay
fragmentation method: LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the dataset identifier PXD037907.
mass analyzer: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
